scope: Actual compiled UI and isolated SQLite API/worker; only discovery and virtual transport are redirected to owned loopback processes. Generated accounts, not public demo credentials.
checks: Generated Club Admin signs into the rebuilt client and receives only its authorised directory.
Phone Teams opens the authorised directory with Open/Manage actions and no configuration form or horizontal overflow.
Club reports load automatically, retain the current report after selecting its club again, and fit the tablet viewport.
Account Help, Privacy and real request status remain readable; internal references are optional and no privacy request is submitted.
Real logout closes private Club Admin views on the rebuilt client.
